common.mamode: Moving-average algorithm; choose one of the listed values.
common.scalar: Multiplier applied to the formula output.
common.adjust: Use normalized exponential weights instead of recursive EMA weights.
common.sma: Seed EMA with the simple average of its first window.
common.asc: Use ascending weights; False reverses their order.
common.cumulative: Compound returns over history instead of returning each interval.
common.ddof: Degrees of freedom subtracted from the variance denominator.
common.use_tr: Use true range instead of High - Low for Keltner width.
common.use_true_range: Use true range instead of High - Low for channel width.
common.multiplier: Volatility multiplier controlling band width or stop distance.
common.rvi_length: Relative Volatility Index lookback in bars.
common.asbool: Return boolean signal channels instead of numeric flags.
common.asint: Return numeric 0/1 flags instead of booleans.
common.left: Earlier bars on the left of a pivot candidate.
common.right: Later bars required to confirm a pivot candidate.
common.occurrence: Zero-based matching event: 0 selects the latest event.
common.offset: Evaluate the current fitted line at length - 1 - offset; negatives extrapolate that fit.
common.anchor: Datetime grouping frequency for VWAP, such as D, W, or M.
common.annualization: Periods per year for annualized volatility.
common.as_angle: Apply arctangent to convert slope into an angle.
common.to_degrees: Express the angle in degrees instead of radians when as_angle is enabled.
common.coef: Volatility threshold coefficient for money flow.
common.vcoef: Multiplier limiting volume relative to average volume.
common.distribution_offset: Relative location of the ALMA weight center.
common.floor: Round the ALMA weight center down when True.
common.sigma: Controls the ALMA Gaussian weight width.
common.handle_na: Use High - Low when previous Close is missing; otherwise mark that observation invalid.
common.developing: Use the current anchored interval instead of the previous complete interval.
common.method: Pivot-point formula family; choose one of the listed methods.
common.end_type: Use close or high/low prices to position ATR stop bands.
common.divisor: Volume scaling divisor in ease of movement.
common.double: Second smoothing period for stochastic momentum.
common.fastlimit: Maximum adaptive smoothing factor for MAMA.
common.slowlimit: Minimum adaptive smoothing factor for MAMA.
common.fastmatype: Moving-average type code for the fast MACD component.
common.slowmatype: Moving-average type code for the slow MACD component.
common.signalmatype: Moving-average type code for the MACD signal.
common.initial: Starting value of the volume index.
common.jaw: Slow jaw smoothing period, without a plotting shift.
common.teeth: Middle teeth smoothing period, without a plotting shift.
common.lips: Fast lips smoothing period, without a plotting shift.
common.senkou: Long-span lookback; outputs remain on the input index.
common.ln: Use natural logarithms instead of base-10 logarithms.
common.lookback: Window used to classify the moving-average trend.
common.maxperiod: Upper bound for variable moving-average periods.
common.minperiod: Lower bound for variable moving-average periods.
common.mode: Decay function; choose one of the listed modes.
common.name: Moving-average family for this generic moving-average call.
common.penetration: Fractional penetration required to confirm the candle pattern.
common.period: Cycle lookback for the sine wave.
common.poles: Number of poles in the Super Smoother.
common.rank: Lookback for the Connors RSI return rank.
common.stdev_mult: Volume-weighted population standard-deviation multiplier for VWAP bands.
common.streak: RSI period applied to the consecutive up/down streak.
common.strict: Require every adjacent comparison in the window to satisfy the direction.
common.above: Use upward entry-threshold crossings; False uses downward crossings.
common.xa: Entry threshold in the input signal units.
common.xb: Exit threshold in the input signal units.
common.long: Track long instead of short signal state.
common.fast_w: Weight of the fast Ultimate Oscillator component.
common.medium_w: Weight of the medium Ultimate Oscillator component.
common.slow_w: Weight of the slow Ultimate Oscillator component.
common.offsetonreverse: SAR adjustment on a direction reversal.
common.startvalue: Initial SAR value; its sign selects the initial direction when nonzero.
common.trade_offset: Nonnegative bar shift of entry/exit signal series.
common.p: ATR and first stop window in bars.
common.x: ATR multiplier for the initial stop.
common.tvmode: Use the TradingView-style Chande Kroll formula instead of the book variant.

ta.cdl_doji.factor: Maximum candle body as percentage points of the preceding average range.

ta.qqe.factor: Multiplier for smoothed RSI volatility bands.

ta.stc.factor: Recursive smoothing coefficient for the stochastic cycle.

ta.accbands.c: High-low acceleration multiplier for the bands.

ta.ma_envelopes.percent: Envelope width as percentage points; 2.5 means 2.5%.

ta.zscore.std: Scale factor applied to standard deviation in the denominator.

ta.mode.length: Number of most recent finite observations, rather than consecutive bars.

ta.stochrsi.k: Smoothing period for the stochastic RSI %K line.
ta.stochrsi.length: Stochastic window applied to RSI values.

ta.shift.length: Nonnegative lag in bars; earlier values move to later bars.

ta.fisher.signal: Bar lag of the Fisher line used for its signal output.
